text:
deploy-bot: Starting prod rollout for auth-service v4.7.0 in change window 22:00-22:30 UTC. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-auth-v4.7.0 :rocket; post decision to #deploy-notify.
emily: oncall ack. I'll own rollback for first 15m. Ping me on any canary hold.
raj: Release lead. Abort if 5xx > 0.9% for 3m OR p95 latency > 200ms for 4m. If transient spike <10m with no errors, consider pinning traffic.
sre-oncall: Preflight checks green. Enabling automated canary-check to post a hold to this thread on threshold breach. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/auth-service/canary-v4.7.0
ops_kim: Runbook note: DB migration is behind feature-flag. If rollback, DISABLE feature-flag first (runbook step 4b) then switch traffic. Do NOT purge caches until DB state verified. I added a small checklist to the runbook.
support_maya: CS line ready if rollback: "We reverted a routine deployment and restored the previous stable version; services are stable."
docs_oleg: Holding changelog PR; prepared revert template to merge quickly if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary stage1: 10% traffic. Will update at 50% or on any hold.
emily: Stage1 metrics look fine. Proceeding to 50%. Will post final at 50% or on any alert. :white_check_mark:
